scripts.column-fieldless-run.sh:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
while [ ! -f /home/mgsloan/column-pow2-20260914/pow2-complete ]; do sleep 10; done
tar -xzf /home/mgsloan/column-fieldless-cloud.tar.gz -C /home/mgsloan
cd /home/mgsloan/column-fieldless-20260914
python3 benchmark-kernel-probes.py . --kind query --variants exact,control,super,fieldless,fieldlesssuper --job-variants job-variants.json --points 1,0 --rounds 3 --repeat 5 --tag fieldless-queries
python3 benchmark-kernel-probes.py . --kind walk --variants exact,control,super,fieldless,fieldlesssuper --job-variants job-variants.json --points 1,0 --rounds 3 --repeat 5 --tag fieldless-walks
touch fieldless-complete
